nodes.title: The Game of Dice
nodes.historical_context: Yudhishthira accepts Dhritarashtra's invitation to a game of dice in Hastinapura. Shakuni plays on Duryodhana's behalf with loaded dice.

nodes.title: The Humiliation of Draupadi
nodes.historical_context: Having lost Draupadi in the final wager, Duhshasana drags her into the royal assembly. She challenges the Kuru elders on jurisprudence and dharma.
